name: San Francisco

categories.label: Skyscrapers built
categories.hint: 1 VP per skyscraper figure on your city board.

categories.label: Bonus tokens (1.5 VP)
categories.hint: 1.5 VP per bonus token next to your board.

categories.label: District completion tokens
categories.hint: 1 VP per hexagonal token for being first to fill a district row (5 cards).

categories.label: District advantage tokens
categories.hint: Sum of token values: 4p 1st +2, 2nd +1, 4th -1; 3p 1st +2, 2nd +1; 2p 1st +2. Rank by card value; ties by leftmost card.

categories.label: Cable car tokens on board
categories.hint: Tiebreaker only: more cable car tokens wins.

tiebreakers.description: Most cable car tokens on the city board
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Game ends immediately when the last foundation token is placed or a player fills their city board. District/network advantage tokens are entered as the token values won because ties are broken by leftmost card values (district) or leftmost-column cable cars (network), then by the player who ended the game. Verified against the Polish Rebel rulebook (no English PDF reachable); cross-checked with an English review.
